general_information.Description: The purpose of this course is to equip students with the detailed understanding and knowledge of the package. It will also equip students with the essential practical and technical skills necessary for packaging design. Scope of evaluation will include target customers, brand language, personality and persuasion, concept creation, colour application, ergonomics, layout design, print finishing and materials... The challenges of designing for the future will also be considered; ensuring that environmental and ethical issues relating to the packaging industry are measured and applied.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Attend at least 80% of contact hours in order to be eligible for the final examination. - Actively participate in class activities. - Fulfil tasks given by the instructor after class. - Use their own laptop in class only for learning purposes. Computers have to have some version of design software installed, such as Photoshop or Illustrator for design assignments, and PowerPoint for presentations. - Read the textbook in advance.

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Understanding the Fundamentals of packaging design: Combine the functional, aesthetic, and legal aspects of packaging

Analyze Materials, printing techniques, and market research: Merge the knowledge of materials and printing with market analysis skills. Evaluate packaging designs through a sustainability lens, considering material choices, life-cycle impact, and end-of-use strategies (recycling, composting, etc).
Develop Branding concepts and design: Focus on the brand creation process, including naming and visual design implementation
Research, Ideation and Collaborative design: Combine research, analysis, brainstorming, and teamwork for design development
Presentation and Communication skills: emphasize the importance of presenting and defending design choices, along with group collaboration.
Market Awareness and adaptability: highlight the need to understand market trends and adjust designs accordingly, building upon the proactive attitude from.
Professional Work ethic: reinforce the importance of working under pressure, adhering to legal requirements, the AI era and maintaining a proactive approach.

assessments.Question Type: A (personal) job through 3 phases that demonstrates students' ability to understand and apply knowledge about designing a packaging system from research stage to design completion stage in practice.
assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Assignment 1: Market Research and Design Direction Proposal for a Packaging System(Choose a company/shop/brand in any product category)Deliverables:1. A PDF file presenting the Market Research and the Packaging System Design Direction.2. A PDF file documenting the process of AI application and evidence of personal adjustments during the project development.Requirements:The research and design direction must cover the following components: * Market Research - Brand introduction: trade name, market segment, sales channels (traditional market/supermarket/e-commerce), target distribution areas. - Products: shape, specifications/volumes, features–functions–usage, current materials, product lines/categories. Include visual illustrations. - Customer personas: minimum of 2 personas with visual representation, purchasing behavior, motivations–barriers, and packaging selection criteria. - Product market development (if applicable): domestic/export, specific requirements (transportation, display, legal compliance). - Competitors (direct/indirect): logos, key products, SWOT analysis, quick comparison on “physical shelf” and “digital shelf” (thumbnail effect in online display). * Packaging Direction (present 3 distinct directions) - Packaging levels: Primary, Secondary, Tertiary packaging applicable to each product line (SKU). - Design direction: structure/die-cut/materials; style–color palette–typography. Present design direction with moodboards, proposed color schemes, fonts, reference images/icons, and sample packaging design examples.
assessments.Grading Guide: - Have Full range of items required - Research carefully - Present aesthetically and professionally - Create packaging design orientation suitable to customers.
